system.description: Ranged attacks with thrown weapons, with no martial armor and no shields equipped, earn 1 Momentum Point to a maximum of 5, and your thrown attacks deal extra damage equal to your current Momentum. When a creature hits you with an attack against Defense you must spend all your Momentum and add an equal amount to your Defense against that attack — which can turn the hit into a miss. Momentum is lost at the end of each scene, or the moment you equip a shield or martial armor. A defence you cannot decline.
